# Research pathways and paper coverage {#sec-research-map .unnumbered}

This map turns the bibliography into a sequence of research questions. Its
literature cutoff is **22 October 2026**. The selection emphasizes results that
introduce a method, connect previously separate subjects, or expose an assumption
that a new researcher must learn to test. It is not an exhaustive index of every
paper published or posted during 2026. A recent submission is included as a
preprint when no verified publication is recorded.

A productive reading sequence has three passes: reproduce a sharply defined
object in a tractable limit; understand how the paper controls its approximation
or inference; then identify an extension for which that control can survive.
The [research workshop](32-research-workshop.qmd) develops this process in
complete project plans. The [computational laboratory](computational-laboratory.qmd)
provides smaller verified calculations that establish conventions before a
full-scale reproduction.

## What the source investigation establishes

The source-level records are the [thermalization and driven-matter
ledger](research/thermal.md), [transport and integrability
ledger](research/transport.md), and [information-dynamics
ledger](research/information.md). They record primary links and evidence
qualifications. An abstract check establishes authorship, title, version,
publication status where available, and the authors' stated claims. Inspecting
selected full-text equations or arguments is stronger but still does not amount
to independently validating every proof, simulation, or experimental uncertainty.
The transport ledger labels these levels explicitly; other entries should be
read with their stated audit limitations.

The textbook's elementary derivations are calculations developed for teaching.
Their presence is not a claim to have rederived every technical result of a
cited frontier paper. Distinguish a theorem under hypotheses, a controlled
approximation, a model-specific exact result, numerical convergence, finite-time
experimental evidence, and a proposed mechanism. Publication is valuable
scrutiny but does not erase a result's hypotheses. Conversely, a preprint can
supply a precise reproducible result while its broader interpretation remains
open.

## From a pure state to local statistical mechanics

Begin with [states and information](01-state-information.qmd), [models and
symmetries](02-models-symmetries.qmd), and [unitary quenches](03-unitary-dynamics.qmd).
The first landmark path is geometrical: Schmidt decomposition explains local
mixedness; the Haar two-copy identity gives a directly reproducible average
purity; Page's entropy benchmark and canonical typicality explain why small
subsystems of typical constrained states can look thermal
[@page1993average; @popescu2006foundations]. The object to reproduce is a
reduced density matrix or its moments, with the ensemble measure stated.
Typicality alone supplies neither a dynamical route nor a relaxation time.

The dynamical path runs from Deutsch and Srednicki to the explicit
thermalization studies of Rigol, Dunjko, and Olshanii
[@deutsch1991statistical; @srednicki1994chaos; @rigol2008thermalization].
In [ETH](06-equilibration-eth.qmd), calculate an observable's diagonal matrix
elements versus energy, its off-diagonal variance versus frequency, and the
post-quench diagonal-ensemble value in a resolved symmetry sector. The central
question is whether one smooth thermodynamic function describes the relevant
eigenstates, not whether one time trace looks flat. Narrow energy support,
observable locality, sector resolution, and system-size growth all matter.

A 2026 continuation is @serbyn2026firstorder: semiclassics and exact
diagonalization in all-to-all models motivate a generalized eigenstate structure
near thermal first-order coexistence. Reproduce the branch-resolved observable
distribution, rather than extrapolating the claim immediately to every
short-range Hamiltonian. An achievable extension asks which coexistence signatures
persist under controlled changes of interaction range or symmetry. The open
problem is how spatial nucleation, thermodynamic limits, and branch mixing alter
that eigenstate picture.

## Spectral chaos, local scrambling, and accessible information

The [spectral-chaos chapter](07-spectral-chaos.qmd) begins with elementary spacing
laws and gap ratios, then moves to the spectral form factor. Oganesyan and Huse
made symmetry-resolved ratio statistics a practical many-body diagnostic;
Atas and collaborators supplied useful distribution surmises
[@oganesyan2007localization; @atas2013ratios]. A first reproduction should compare
resolved and deliberately mixed sectors of the same Hamiltonian. This exposes
why unresolved symmetry can imitate Poisson statistics.

Analytic circuit and kicked-model studies connect spatial dynamics to spectral
universality [@kos2018chaos; @chan2018spectral; @bertini2018spectral]. Reproduce
$\langle|\operatorname{Tr}U^t|^2\rangle$, specifying averaging, disconnected
contributions, and the order of length and time limits. A fixed-time
thermodynamic result is not a uniform finite-system theorem at exponentially
long times. The original dual-kicked-Ising form-factor paper also distinguishes
its odd-time proof from its even-time conjecture.

The [scrambling chapter](09-scrambling.qmd) follows a different observable:
operator weight or an out-of-time-ordered correlator. The exact random-circuit
fronts of @nahum2018operator and @vonkeyserlingk2018operator provide a
reproducible baseline. The thermal chaos bound [@info-mss2016] applies under
analyticity and factorization assumptions; it does not bound every exponential
fit to a finite-qubit OTOC. Teleportation-based proposals distinguish scrambling
from decoherence under stated protocol assumptions [@info-yoshida2019].
A useful research question is which experimentally affordable combination of
observables rules out a noise mechanism that would otherwise mimic information
loss.

## Entanglement growth, circuits, and deeper forms of randomness

The route through [entanglement](08-entanglement-growth.qmd) and
[circuits](10-quantum-circuits.qmd) connects three descriptions. Calabrese and
Cardy relate quench entanglement to propagating correlated excitations;
Alba and Calabrese incorporate interacting Bethe quasiparticles and their
thermodynamic entropy [@info-calabrese2005; @alba2017entanglement]. Reproduce an
interval entropy and its initial growth rate, checking initial-state pairing
structure and which entropy is being calculated.

Noisy circuits provide controlled statistical-mechanics mappings
[@nahum2017growth; @info-zhou2019]. Membrane theories organize coarse-grained
entropy in more general chaotic dynamics [@info-jonay2018; @zhou2020membrane].
The object is an entropy or purity with a specified average: the logarithm of an
averaged purity and the average of its logarithm are different. Comparing them
is an instructive first calculation. The open question is how conservation,
finite local dimension, and deterministic microscopic structure modify the
coarse-grained membrane and its fluctuations.

Unitary designs ask for agreement with Haar randomness through specified
moments, a stronger question than one reduced density matrix being thermal
[@info-brandao2016]. Projected ensembles, formed by measuring the complement
of a subsystem, expose higher moments of individual many-body wavefunctions
[@info-cotler2023; @info-choi2023random]. Preserve outcome probabilities in any
reproduction; uniform weighting changes the ensemble. Charge-conserving deep
thermalization [@info-chang2025] adds a nontrivial constraint to the target
ensemble.

In 2026, random-permutation models exhibit coherence-controlled deep
thermalization [@info-liu2026], and mixed-state extensions combine exact solvable
subclasses with generic-model numerical evidence [@info-sherry2026]. The
September review preprint @info-mark2026 synthesizes this developing field;
it is a guide to distinctions, not a new universal proof. A useful next problem
is whether a chosen higher moment equilibrates under a realistic conservation
law and measurement basis, and how many samples its certification actually
requires. Worst-case limits such as @info-du2026 should be compared with the
structure of the proposed protocol rather than treated as forbidding all
efficient special cases.

## From microscopic currents to integrable fluids

The [hydrodynamics](11-hydrodynamics.qmd) and
[response](12-linear-response.qmd) route begins with a bond-current commutator,
then derives susceptibility, fluctuation–dissipation, conductivity, and projection
bounds [@kubo1957response; @mazur1969bound]. Reproduce the same coefficient
from density spreading and a current integral whenever both descriptions apply.
A vanishing Drude weight does not select diffusion; a finite-size current plateau
does not establish an infinite-time ballistic component.

[Integrability](13-integrability.qmd) progresses from two-magnon scattering to
Bethe quantization, root/hole counting, Yang–Yang entropy, TBA, and dressing
[@bethe1931chain; @yang1969thermodynamics]. The discovery of current-overlapping
quasilocal charges [@prosen2011drude] explains why familiar short-range charges
can miss transport protection. Reproduce a thermodynamic integral equation and
verify a susceptibility in two independent ways before solving a dynamical
problem. Charge completeness and the intended observable class are part of
the scientific question.

The independent 2016 GHD papers [@castro2016ghd; @bertini2016ghd] combine local
stationary ensembles with self-consistent quasiparticle velocities. In
[GHD](14-ghd.qmd), solve a partitioning protocol, calculate both density and
current profiles, and compare to a microscopic benchmark. The free-domain-wall
laboratory supplies a fully checked first stage. The interacting extension must
retain the correct species and scattering kernel. Diffusive GHD
[@denardis2019diffusion] shows how fluctuations of collision histories broaden
trajectories even without integrability breaking. The reviews
[@bertini2021transport; @doyon2025perspective] orient the next calculation:
forces, fluctuations, weak collisions, or experimentally realized gases.

## Anomalous transport and partial universality

The [anomalous-transport chapter](15-anomalous-transport.qmd) follows the sequence
from the 2017 weak-domain-wall superdiffusive exponent to the 2019 Heisenberg
scaling-function evidence [@ljubotina2017spin; @ljubotina2019kpz]. Kinetic theory
and giant quasiparticles explain the divergent diffusion estimate
[@gopalakrishnan2019kinetic; @ilievski2021super]. Reproduce the normalized
structure factor, a width, a local amplitude, and a current integral; a single
power-law fit leaves too many alternatives.

The next link is a caution with positive scientific content. A single Burgers
field cannot reproduce the exact spin-reversal symmetry of equilibrium
transferred magnetization. Coupled-mode proposals, processor measurements of
higher moments, and additional two-point tests establish a more nuanced picture
[@denardis2023nlfh; @rosenberg2024magnetization; @takeuchi2025partial].
KPZ-compatible two-point scaling and non-KPZ higher statistics can coexist.
Determining the full dynamical distribution remains more demanding than finding
$z=3/2$.

Near integrability, calculate decay rates of large bound states rather than
assuming one scattering time [@denardis2021stability]. The 2026 preprint
@anand2026robustness reports long-lived KPZ-like spreading in long-range chains;
its suggested proximity-to-integrability mechanism is conjectural, and finite-time
agreement does not prove asymptotic nonintegrable KPZ. The relaxation-time
crossover in @santra2026crossover is an explicit collision approximation. Forced
GHD in @scopa2026bloch predicts finite-density impurity oscillations without a
lattice. These provide three distinct extensions: a numerical robustness
question, a model kinetic crossover, and a quantitative integrable-gas prediction.

## Exact chaotic laboratories and their boundaries

[Dual-unitary circuits](16-exact-circuits.qmd) replace an uncontrolled many-body
contraction by unitary cancellations in two orientations. @bertini2019dual
reduces local infinite-temperature correlators to channels on light rays;
@bertini2019entanglement constructs entanglement dynamics for solvable initial
states. Reproduce a gate's reshuffled unitarity, its channel eigenvalues, and
then explicit small-chain correlators. A phased-SWAP gate is a necessary
counterexample: dual unitarity can coexist with persistent nonmixing modes.

The 2026 review @bertini2026duality places these methods in a broader
space–time-duality program. A controlled extension perturbs the gate away from
dual unitarity and measures the first appearance of interior correlations or
front broadening. The limitation is nonuniformity in time: a small defect per
gate can accumulate over an increasing space–time region. An exact result for
one observable or initial-state class does not establish tractability of all
higher moments.

## Localization, avalanches, scars, and constrained connectivity

[Disorder](17-disorder-localization.qmd) begins with Anderson orbitals and then
asks what interaction does to local memory and entanglement
[@anderson1958diffusion; @serbyn2013entanglement; @serbyn2013liom;
@huse2014phenomenology]. Reproduce the two-l-bit dephasing calculation before
interpreting logarithmic entropy as evidence in a large microscopic model.
Imbrie's construction [@imbrie2016localization] has a specified one-dimensional
model and level-statistics assumption; its scope should not be silently enlarged
to every random spin chain.

The [avalanche route](18-mbl-transition.qmd) couples localization to ETH:
a thermal inclusion has an exponentially small level spacing and correspondingly
small bath matrix elements, but their ratio can favor resonant growth
[@deroeck2017stability; @thiery2018avalanche]. Bath-coupled calculations
[@morningstar2022avalanches] test related relaxation scales; they are not
identical to an isolated infinite system. A first project compares fixed-bath and
growing-bath estimates with one consistent localization-length convention.
The finite-size delocalization observations of @li2025delocalization add
experimental constraints without proving instability of every conceivable
localized model in two dimensions.

[Scars and constraints](19-scars-constraints.qmd) ask different questions.
State-dependent Rydberg revivals motivate scar eigenstates and approximate
ladders [@bernien2017simulator; @turner2018scars; @choi2019scars]. Exact embedded
states and fragmented connectivity expose other mechanisms
[@shiraishi2017counterexamples; @sala2020fragmentation; @khemani2020shattering].
Reproduce a restricted graph, its connected components, and the leakage of an
approximate revival subspace. The 2026 preprints @desaules2026frustrated and
@petrova2026orbits extend these questions to frustrated arrays and integrable
spin-chain orbit structures. Their operational definitions matter: “scar” need
not mean that the entire surrounding Hamiltonian is nonintegrable.

## Driven matter and the lifetime of engineered behavior

The [Floquet chapter](20-floquet.qmd) connects exact period evolution to
micromotion and controlled high-frequency expansions. The methodological review
@bukov2015floquet and heating/effective-Hamiltonian results
[@abanin2015heating; @kuwahara2016magnus; @abanin2017effective] show why optimal
truncation can be useful even when a full thermodynamic Magnus series does not
converge. Reproduce a two-step BCH sign, then compare heating and local
observables against successively improved effective descriptions.

[Time crystals](21-time-crystals.qmd) connect emergent symmetry to many-body
order [@khemani2016phases; @else2016crystals; @yao2017crystals;
@else2017prethermal]. An isolated perfect pulse producing period doubling is a
control experiment, not a phase demonstration. A reproduction must test pulse
error, spatial correlations, initial conditions, and lifetime scaling.
Experiments [@kyprianidis2021prethermal; @mi2022crystal] exemplify complementary
prethermal and eigenstate-order diagnostics.

In 2026, multitone control of a driven bosonic lattice
[@cruickshank2026multitone] and period-tripling qutrit experiments
[@goss2026qutrit] extend the available tools. The former does not inherit every
bounded-spin heating theorem; the latter remains a finite 15-qutrit preprint
observation. An achievable extension separates intrinsic heating from control
noise and tests whether a proposed lifetime law survives equal-resource
comparison of the complete protocols.

## Baths, records, and measurement-generated codes

The foundational generators of Gorini–Kossakowski–Sudarshan and Lindblad
[@info-gks1976; @info-lindblad1976] organize the
[open-system chapter](22-open-systems.qmd). Reproduce amplitude damping from
Kraus maps, then compare a direct Liouvillian with the
[trajectory](23-trajectories.qmd) average for the same generator
[@info-daley2014]. A chosen environmental measurement defines the unraveling;
conditional entropy need not equal entropy of the unconditional density matrix.
Markov, weak-coupling, and secular assumptions belong in a microscopic derivation.

[Dissipative phases](24-dissipative-phases.qmd) connect engineered reservoirs,
exact solvability, and Liouvillian spectra
[@info-diehl2008; @info-verstraete2009; @info-prosen2008;
@info-minganti2018]. Reproduce a dark state and test uniqueness and mixing time
separately. Boundary-driven XX/XXZ solutions
[@znidaric2011dephasing; @prosen2011ness] supply concrete transport laboratories,
with strong bias distinguished from equilibrium linear response.

The [measurement-transition](25-measurement-transitions.qmd) path begins with
Clifford numerics and restricted percolation mappings
[@info-li2018; @info-skinner2019], then Born-weighted replica theories
[@info-bao2020]. Reproduce conditional entropies and purification with outcome
probabilities retained. Percolation results for a zeroth Rényi entropy or a
special limit should not be assigned automatically to generic von Neumann
criticality.

The [error-correction chapter](26-information-error-correction.qmd) connects
this dynamics to references, decoupling, and recoverability
[@info-knill1997; @info-hayden2007; @info-choi2020;
@info-gullans2020pur; @info-gullans2020probe]. Reproduce a small explicit
recovery map rather than declaring that an encoded state supplies an efficient
decoder. Experiments [@info-noel2022; @info-hoke2023] add finite-device evidence
with protocol-specific decoding and mitigation. The October 2026 preprint
@cemin2026graphs asks how sparse graph geometry organizes Clifford information
spreading and code distance. Testing spectral dimension against other geometric
invariants is an accessible continuation; its studied circuit architectures do
not establish a theorem for every sparse hardware graph.

## Critical fields, gauge constraints, and the next numerical method

[Critical dynamics](27-critical-dynamics.qmd) makes universal scaling concrete
through mode-resolved Ising Landau–Zener passage [@dziarmaga2005ising], return-rate
singularities [@heyl2013dqpt], and variational control [@sels2017counterdiabatic].
Reproduce finite-endpoint ramps before invoking infinite-passage formulas.
Differentiate a thermodynamic cusp from an isolated finite-size zero and from a
transition in a local observable.

[Kinetics and field theory](28-kinetics-field-theory.qmd) connects the closed-time
contour, response/noise, collision invariants, and self-similar occupation spectra
[@berges2005nonequilibrium; @sieberer2016keldysh; @schmied2019fixed].
The experiments [@prufer2018universal; @erne2018universal] motivate testing
initial-condition independence over an observed scaling window. Reproduce a
conserving collision integral and distinguish particle flux through a momentum
window from a violated global conservation law. The 2026 coherence–void proposal
[@mcculloch2026coherence] shows how rare fluctuations can challenge a linearized
field description; its zero-entropy-sector assumptions and conditional
deterministic extension remain part of the claim.

[Long-range, gauge, and topological dynamics](29-long-range-gauge.qmd) ask which
foundational assumptions change. Long-range bounds depend on the observable and
error norm [@tran2020hierarchy]. Gauge constraints change the physical Hilbert
space and the subsystem algebra, affecting entropy definitions
[@casini2014gaugeentropy; @donnelly2014gaugeentropy]. Driven edge topology can
require full micromotion rather than a static band invariant
[@rudner2013anomalous]. Reproduce one restricted gauge sector or a pump before
claiming a general topological many-body dynamical classification.

The 2026 SU(2) gauge-field study @chen2026gauge measures local entanglement-spectrum
and Rényi diagnostics in a minimally truncated plaquette-chain model on quantum
hardware. Its size and mitigation-assisted agreement are evidence about that
model and those local observables, not the full continuum gauge theory.
The engineered hierarchical-symmetry proposal @fu2026hierarchical addresses
protection against gauge-breaking errors through effective theory and numerical
quantum-link models. An immediate research problem separates truncation error,
gauge leakage, Trotter error, and measurement uncertainty in the same protocol.

Finally, [experiments](30-platforms-protocols.qmd) and
[tensor networks](31-tensor-networks.qmd) connect every path to what can actually
be measured and simulated [@cheneau2012lightcone; @brydges2019renyi;
@vidal2004tebd; @haegeman2016tdvp]. A tensor method should converge the target
observable in timestep, rank, and size; norm or energy conservation alone does
not certify accuracy. A randomized estimator needs its sampling and calibration
assumptions as explicitly as a Bethe equation needs its kernel. Keeping those
standards while changing one scientific ingredient is the practical step from
reading a frontier paper to developing a new result.
